reason: We have to leave E-Golf4U anyway, so the timing is right and the price is not the problem. But I am not putting 950 members and our whole invoicing on a two-person company whose first pilot club is not even live yet; if that goes wrong, it is my name on the board decision.
objection: Two founders and zero clubs live. What happens to our member records, invoices and tee sheet if one of them quits or they run out of money, and does it really work alongside GOLF.NL and the handicap system, which our members already use for free?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Golfclub Zwolle running on it for a full season, with their manager telling me personally that the migration and the invoicing went fine, plus a contract clause that hands over all our data in a standard format if Greenside stops.
